ops.title: Validate batch cleanup and routing dependencies before row commit
ops.description:
Owner: drive-lock coordinator (caller).
Next executable step: make committed() capture and validate the rows used by rows_saved() for standing-part cleanup and moved-order notifications, then retry the merge when those dependencies change.
Evidence: cfc47e545 plugins/long-running/lib/drive/state.py:5044 supplies only written rows and no revision/read set. rows_saved() computes drop_ended_texts before the lock and uses base/mine bindings for moved notifications. standing_part() reads the job's own and carried orders. A concurrent write that marks its part standing after now=load() is not checked, so finishing the codex job can discard undelivered texts that the current standing part must retain. A concurrent subcoordinator binding can likewise make a refile omit ORDERS_MOVED. The former locked whole-save merged and computed these from the current drive under writing().
Static review only; no tests run.

ops.text: Concurrent standing-part changes are validated before a batch finishing a job can drop its undelivered texts.
Concurrent subcoordinator binding and order refiling preserve the old whole-save ORDERS_MOVED recipients and destinations.
